title: mail-server and contacts-server patch appliers create missing parents (RFC 8620 §5.3)
description: Same defect fixed in filenode-server memory.rs (JMAP-4vf8.20): crate-jmap-mail-server/src/memory/mod.rs:~2109 and crate-jmap-contacts-server/src/card.rs:~363 have local apply-patch copies that build missing pointer parents instead of rejecting with invalidPatch. Unverified by test.
